description: A sprite sheet of FOUR separate medieval village props arranged in a 2 by 2 grid, each centered in its own quarter: top-left a small market stall with a red and white striped cloth awning and crates of fruit and vegetables on the counter; top-right a small market stall with a blue cloth awning and rolls of colorful fabric on the counter; bottom-left a round stone water well with a small wooden roof and a bucket; bottom-right a wooden direction signpost with two pointed arrow boards, drawn in straight FRONT VIEW like the reference (facing the camera, slight top-down), thick dark outline, soft cel shading, every object fully separate with empty transparent space around it, no ground, no shadow puddles, no text, no characters

style_image.usage_description: Copy ONLY the art style of this reference: chunky chibi pixel art, thick dark outline on every shape, soft cel shading, warm saturated palette, front-facing view. Do not draw this house or tree.
